name: 01. Basic Integer Declaration
description: Demonstrates valid integer variable declaration and literal initialization with semicolon.

name: 02. Floating-Point Numbers
description: Demonstrates valid float declarations, decimal literal tokenization, and output.

name: 03. Operator Precedence (* before +)
description: Verifies that multiplication and division take precedence over addition and subtraction.

name: 04. Grouped Parentheses Expressions
description: Tests expression evaluation where parentheses override standard operator precedence.

name: 05. Multi-Statement Computation
description: Demonstrates sequential variable declarations, re-assignments, and print statements.

name: 06. Syntax Error: Missing Semicolon
description: Demonstrates detection of missing semicolon at end of declaration and reporting exact line/col.

name: 07. Syntax Error: Unmatched Parenthesis
description: Demonstrates parser detection of unmatched opening parenthesis '(' without closing ')'.

name: 08. Lexical Error: Illegal Characters
description: Demonstrates scanner detection of unsupported characters like '@' and '$'.

name: 09. Lexical Error: Malformed Number
description: Detects invalid floating-point literal with multiple decimal points.

name: 10. Semantic Error: Undeclared Variable
description: Detects assignment and expression reading of an undeclared identifier 'speed'.

name: 11. Semantic Error: Duplicate Declaration
description: Detects re-declaration of an identifier already present in the current symbol table.

name: 12. Semantic Error: Static Division by Zero
description: Detects compile-time static division by literal zero.

name: 13. Full Pipeline Showcase Program
description: Comprehensive demonstration of declarations, arithmetic precedence, grouping, TAC, and output.
